conclusion: No blanket confirmed-meaning prerequisite for every structural test, or unjustified flat copying/context null, verified in these18 current reviews. Several original proposals do contain flat-context assumptions, and their effective reviews specifically correct them. Missing independently justified semantic endpoints apply to the stated semantic inference, not to all possible structural questions.
limits: No claim that each proposal is well-designed or that all36 method reviews are sound. No newly nominated structural discriminator or supplied endpoint emerged from this read-only design audit. No empirical manuscript test was rerun.
important_interpretation: new_binding gates must remain scoped to each declared endpoint. They cannot be used downstream to require confirmed English/German lexemes before a distinct, properly specified structural test. That potential misuse is not evidence these particular review rows contain the error.
